items.source: Register a proxy for the referenced type that also implements the given proxyInterfaces.
items.translation: 为引用的类型注册一个代理，该代理还需实现指定的 proxyInterfaces。

items.source: Configure the referenced type for reflective access by providing at least one MemberCategory.
items.translation: 通过提供至少一个MemberCategory来配置用于反射访问的引用类型。

items.source: Configure the referenced type for usage with Querydsl by registering hints for potential Q types.
items.translation: 通过为潜在的Q类型注册提示，配置用于与Querydsl一起使用的引用类型。

items.source: Contribute generated cglib accessors for the referenced type.
items.translation: 为引用的类型贡献生成的 CGlib 访问器。

items.source: Configure the referenced type as a repository proxy.
items.translation: 将引用的类型配置为存储库代理。

items.source: Configure the referenced type as a spring proxy interface.
items.translation: 将引用的类型配置为 Spring 代理接口。

items.source: Configure the referenced type as a projection interface returned by eg. a query method.
items.translation: 将引用的类型配置为查询方法返回的投影接口。

items.source: Can be disabled by user configuration (spring.aot.data.accessors.enabled). Honors in/exclusions set by user configuration spring.aot.data.accessors.include / spring.aot.data.accessors.exclude
items.translation: 可通过用户配置（`spring.aot.data.accessors.enabled`）禁用。支持通过用户配置的包含/排除规则 `spring.aot.data.accessors.include` / `spring.aot.data.accessors.exclude` 进行设置。

items.source: Configure the referenced type for data binding. In case of Annotation only data ones are considered. For more fine-grained control use forReflectiveAccess(MemberCategory...).
items.translation: 配置用于数据绑定的引用类型。如果是Annotation，仅考虑数据注解。如需更细粒度的控制，请使用forReflectiveAccess(MemberCategory...)。

items.source:
Configuration object that captures various AOT configuration aspects of types within the data context by offering
predefined methods to register native configuration necessary for data binding, projection proxy definitions, AOT
cglib bytecode generation and other common tasks.
items.translation: 一个配置对象，通过提供预定义方法来注册数据绑定所需的本机配置、投影代理定义、AOT cglib 字节码生成以及其他常见任务，从而捕获数据上下文中类型的各种 AOT 配置方面。

items.source: Configure the referenced type for data binding.
items.translation: 配置用于数据绑定的引用类型。
